title: refactor(parser,schema,db,advisor,taskrun): bump omni to c5928e2 and unify plugin registration APIs
body:
## Summary

Bumps `github.com/bytebase/omni` to `c5928e25ca70` (`5f4c67b3eed3..c5928e25ca70`, 17 commits) and simplifies the `backend/plugin/{parser,schema,db,advisor}` APIs and adapter footprint (net **-1,837** non-test Go lines and **-149** non-test Go files across `backend/plugin`, bringing `backend/plugin/{advisor,parser,schema,db}` from 318 files / ~27.0k lines down to **169 files / 25.1k lines**).

### Key Changes

1. **Unified Parser Plugin API (`backend/plugin/parser/base` + 22 engine packages + `standard`)**
   - Replaced 13 separate global capability maps, 3 mutexes, and 13 inconsistently named `Register*` functions with a single declarative `base.Engine` capability struct and `base.Register(spec base.Engine, targetEngines ...storepb.Engine)` backed by one map and one mutex (preserving disjoint multi-call registration and panicking with engine + capability name on duplicate registration).
   - Consolidated 5 tiny single-type fragment files in `parser/base` (`ast.go`, `base.go`, `query.go`, `transform.go`, `mysql_complete.go`) into their natural homes (`statement.go`, `errors.go`, `span.go`, `backup.go`, `complete_helpers.go`).
   - Consolidated 182 scattered `init()` calls across 206 parser files down to **57 cohesive files**, giving every engine a single top-of-file `base.Register(base.Engine{...}, ...)` manifest that makes per-engine capabilities and cross-engine sharing (e.g., PostgreSQL/CockroachDB/Snowflake, MySQL/ClickHouse/StarRocks/Doris) immediately readable.
   - Removed the last `omni/*/ast` import outside `backend/plugin/` by moving `pg.ExtractPrependStatement` onto `omni/pg/analysis.PrependStatements` (`backend/runner/taskrun/database_migrate_executor.go`).
   - Consolidated `base.ToOmniNotFoundError` and `base.ExplainStatementResult`, and unexported `collectUniqueStatementTypes`.

2. **Unified Schema Plugin API (`backend/plugin/schema`)**
   - Replaced 15 separate global maps, 9 `Register*` functions, `call1`/`call2`/`call3`, and the `WalkThrough` vs `WalkThroughWithContext` split with a single `schema.Engine` struct (embedding `schema.Definitions`) and `schema.Register(spec schema.Engine, targetEngines ...storepb.Engine)`.
   - Deduplicated `formatSearchPath` in `schema/pg`, removed unused `PublicSchemaName`, and unexported internal-only `omnicatalog` interfaces.
   - Preserved all four intentional legacy compatibility shims (`pg/legacy_normalize.go`, `mssql/mssql.go`, `oracle/oracle.go`, `mariadb/metadata_migration.go`).

3. **Driver & Advisor Cleanup (`backend/plugin/db`, `backend/plugin/advisor`)**
   - Removed dead `ConnectionContext.MessageBuffer`/`AppendMessage` (`db/driver.go`) and unused `util.TrimStatement` (`db/util/driverutil.go`).
   - Deduplicated all 10 `ExecuteOptions.Log*` methods via a shared `log(action, entry)` helper and fixed the copy-paste log message in `LogDatabaseSyncEnd`, with unit coverage in `backend/plugin/db/driver_test.go`.
   - Unified `mysql`/`snowflake`/`pg`/`mssql` query helpers onto `Om

## Summary
Final wrap-up PR for the engine-code-to-omni migration:

1. **Bump `github.com/bytebase/omni` to `5f4c67b3eed3`** (`go.mod`, `go.sum`)
   - Picks up `omni#1656` and `#1666`–`#1702` (unified `analysis.CandidateType`, Trino `ExplainStatement`, MongoDB `ClassifyStatement`, PartiQL `Candidate.Type`, MySQL/MariaDB/TiDB/OceanBase/PG/Oracle `WALK_THROUGH` & view simulation improvements, MSSQL collation checks, ClickHouse `Decimal`/`UUID`/`Array`/`Tuple`/`Map` tape values, Doris alias function dump fix, Databricks `SHOW FUNCTIONS FROM`, ClickHouse `ATTACH OR REPLACE VIEW`, Trino `CREATE VIEW WITH`, and optional-clause parser coverage), while preserving `godebug x509negativeserial=1`.
2. **Unify all 11 completion adapters onto `omni/analysis.CandidateType`**
   - Added canonical `base.OmniCandidateType` and `base.ConvertOmniCandidates` helpers in `backend/plugin/parser/base/complete_helpers.go` (with exhaustive unit tests in `backend/plugin/parser/base/helpers_test.go`), replacing the superseded `MapMySQLFamilyCandidates`.

3. **Delegate Trino `ExplainStatement` and MongoDB `GetQueryType` to omni**
   - Replaced local Trino AST helpers (`singleStatement`, `explainedText`, `nodeSpan`) in `backend/plugin/parser/trino/explain.go` with `omni/trino/analysis.ExplainStatement` + `base.ExplainStatementResult`.

title: docs: update engine-code-to-omni design doc to reflect completed migration
body:
## Summary

Updates `docs/design/engine-code-to-omni.md` from its original `Proposed` snapshot (`fb411c9453`, ~195k non-test Go lines) to accurately reflect the completed Phase 1–4 engine-code-to-omni migration on `main` (`e25f36564c`, omni pin `ce3f45e89769`, ~28.1k non-test Go lines across 324 files):

- **Footprint & metrics**: Updated non-test Go file and line counts for `backend/plugin/{advisor,parser,schema,db}` (`advisor` 24 files / 5,874 lines; `parser` 208 files / 10,480 lines; `schema` 35 files / 4,087 lines; `db` 57 files / 7,617 lines).
- **Phase 1 (V1 review rules)**: Documented completion across all 10 engines behind `omni/v1review`, `V1Engine` (`v1review_engine.go`, `v1review_mysql_family.go`), live probing (`prober.go`), and the 362 retained YAML parity fixtures.
- **Phase 2 (query analysis & completion)**: Documented delegation across all 22 engine parser packages plus `parser/standard` to `omni/<engine>/analysis` and `omni/<engine>/completion`, the shared `omni/analysis` contract types, deleted legacy parser components (`parser/tokenizer`, `split_test_runner.go`, regex `ValidateSQLForEditor`), and the tracked omni-side `cockroachdb-parser` follow-up.
- **Phase 3 (schema conversion)**: Documented delegation of all 10 engine schema packages to `omni/<engine>/catalog` (and `omni/{clickhouse,trino}/deparse`) via `schema/internal/omnicatalog`, MariaDB's own catalog fork, removal of the Bytebase differ, and the intentional Bytebase-only legacy compatibility shims (`pg/legacy_normalize.go`, `mssql/mssql.go`, `oracle/oracle.go`, `mariadb/metadata_migration.go`).
- **Phase 4 (drivers)**: Documented delegation of all 23 driver packages (covering all 24 `storepb.Engine` values) to `omni/<engine>/driver` via `db/util.OmniAdapter`, movement/removal of direct engine driver SDKs in `go.mod` (`// indirect`), pruning of unused engine testcontainers in `backend/common/testcontainer/`, and the remaining intentional direct dependencies (`pgx/v5`, `lib/pq`, `go-sql-driver/mysql` for `gh-ost`).

## Verification

- Verified all referenced repository paths, Go symbols, omni contract types, line/file counts, and `go.mod` direct vs `// indirect` entries against `origin/main` (`e25f36564c`).
- Confirmed `git diff --stat` modifies only `docs/design/engine-code-to-omni.md` (documentation-only change; Go/frontend/proto gates do not apply per `AGENTS.md`).

## Summary
- **Drop direct `github.com/opensearch-project/opensearch-go/v5` dependency** from `backend/plugin/db/elasticsearch/elasticsearch.go`:
  - Replaced `opensearch-go/v5/signer` and `signer/awsv2` with a small AWS SDK v2 `aws/signer/v4` SigV4 `http.RoundTripper` (`signedHTTP`) signing for service `"es"`, caching credentials via `aws.CredentialsCache`, cloning requests to satisfy the `http.RoundTripper` contract without mutating caller requests, hashing and restoring request bodies (or using the empty-body SHA-256 digest), and closing bodies on error.
  - Added unit tests in `backend/plugin/db/elasticsearch/elasticsearch_test.go` covering GET with nil body (empty SHA-256, credential scope, `X-Amz-Date`, caller request immutability), POST with JSON body (body preservation + exact SigV4 signature match), credential retrieval error propagation, empty region rejection, and `signedTransport` construction.
  - Removed `github.com/opensearch-project/opensearch-go/v5` via `go mod tidy`.
- **Prune dead helpers and narrow visibility in `backend/plugin/db/util/`**:
  - Deleted `pgconn.go` and `pgconn_test.go` (`QuotePGValue`, `PGHostPort` — 0 callers).
  - Removed `ApplyPGTLSConfig` (dropping `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn` from `backend/plugin/db/util/`), `GCPCredentialOption` (dropping `google.golang.org/api/option` from `connection.go`), `QueryColumnExtra` (inlined into `sqlProber.ColumnExtra` so `NewSQLProber` retains `db.ColumnExtraLookup`), top-level `ProbeOmni` (superseded by `(*OmniAdapter).ProbeOmni`), and `NewSessionHolder`.

body:
## Summary
Retires the remaining 4 fake `database/sql/driver` + `dbutil.NewSQLProber` test harnesses under `backend/plugin/advisor/` (`oceanbase`, `pg`, `tidb`) onto `advisor.ProbeRecorder` (following PR #22179), leaving zero `database/sql` or `dbutil.NewSQLProber` references in `backend/plugin/advisor/`.

## Changes (`+122 / -386`, net `-264` lines)
- `backend/plugin/advisor/utils_for_tests.go`:
  - Added optional `ProbeFunc func(pCtx db.ProbeContext, statement string) (db.ProbeResult, error)` callback on `ProbeRecorder` so tests can answer per-statement probes and conditional failures without custom `database/sql/driver` fakes.
  - Pruned dead exported test variable `MockIndexColumnList` (0 callers across the repo).
- `backend/plugin/advisor/oceanbase/`:
  - `common_test.go`, `advisor_statement_affected_row_limit_test.go`, `advisor_insert_row_limit_test.go`: retired the `testOceanBaseExplainDriver` fake `sql/driver` harness, global mutable counters, and `staticPlanProber` onto `advisor.ProbeRecorder`, asserting probe counts via `prober.Probes`.
  - Deleted `probe_sql_test.go`: its sole test wrapped `dbutil.NewSQLProber(sql.OpenDB(...))` to verify `dbutil.QueryColumnExtra`'s SQL string and bound args; 100% of OceanBase `STATEMENT_DISALLOW_OFFLINE_DDL` advisor behavior is already covered via `advisor.ProbeRecorder` / `advisor.ProbeOnly` in `oceanbase/probe_seam_test.go`.
- `backend/plugin/advisor/pg/`:
  - `testutil_test.go`, `advisor_insert_row_limit_test.go`, `advisor_statement_affected_row_limit_test.go`, `advisor_statement_dml_dry_run_test.go`: retired the `explainFake` `sql/driver` harness and `newExplainFakeDB` onto `newExplainProber` (`*advisor.ProbeRecorder` with `ProbeFunc`) and `explainedStatements(prober)`, preserving all existing test cases and assertions.
- `backend/plugin/advisor/tidb/`:
  - `advisor_statement_dml_dry_run_test.go`: retired the `dryRunFakeDriver` fake `sql/driver` harness and global `dryRunFake` state onto `advisor.ProbeRecorder` with `ProbeFunc`, asserting `advisor.ProbeCall` (`Autocommit` and `Statement`) directly across all 7 test cases.

+package ai
+
+import (
+	"context"

+)
+
+func TestChatGeminiSendsToolParametersAsJSONSchema(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	tools := []*v1pb.AIChatToolDefinition{
+		{
+			Name:        "get_overview",
+			Description: "Read the current overview.",
+			ParametersSchema: `{
+				"type": "object",
+				"properties": {"project": {"type": "string"}},
+				"additionalProperties": false
+			}`,
+		},
+		{
+			Name:        "prepare_draft",
+			Description: "Prepare an unsaved draft.",
+			ParametersSchema: `{
+				"type": "object",
+				"properties": {
+					"scope": {
+						"type": "object",
+						"properties": {"project": {"type": "string"}},
+						"required": ["project"],
+						"additionalProperties": false
+					},
+					"targets": {
+						"type": "array",
+						"items": {
+							"type": "object",
+							"properties": {"database": {"type": "string"}},
+							"required": ["database"],
+							"additionalProperties": false
+						}
+					}
+				},
+				"required": ["scope", "targets"],
+				"additionalProperties": false
+			}`,
+		},
+	}
+	var payload struct {
+		Tools []struct {
+			FunctionDeclarations []map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"functionDeclarations"`
+		} `json:"tools"`
+	}
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload))
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+		_, err := w.Write([]byte(`{"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"Hi"}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}]}`))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	prompt := "say hi"
+	response, err := Chat(context.Background(),
+		&storepb.AISetting{Provider: storepb.AISetting_GEMINI, Endpoint: server.URL, Model: "gemini-3.5-flash", ApiKey: "test-key"},
+		&v1pb.AIChatRequest{
+			Messages:        []*v1pb.AIChatMessage{{Role: v1pb.AIChatMessageRole_AI_CHAT_MESSAGE_ROLE_USER, Content: &prompt}},
+			ToolDefinitions: tools,
+		},
+	)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "Hi", response.GetContent())
+	require.Len(t, payload.Tools, 1)
+	declarations := payload.Tools[0].FunctionDeclarations
+	require.Len(t, declarations, len(tools))
+	for i, tool := range tools {
+		declaration := declarations[i]
+		require.NotContains(t, declaration, "parameters")
+		require.Contains(t, declaration, "parametersJsonSchema")
+		require.JSONEq(t, tool.ParametersSchema, string(declaration["parametersJsonSchema"]))
+		var name, description string
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(declaration["name"], &name))
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(declaration["description"], &description))
+		require.Equal(t, tool.Name, name)
+		require.Equal(t, tool.Description, description)
+	}

## Summary

  - Exported `V1StandardCompatEntries` (default when `BackwardCompatibility` receives `nil`), eliminating duplicate compatibility maps across `v1review_mysql_family.go` and `pg/rules.go`.
  - Unified `ColumnComment` and `TableComment` onto a shared `commentBatch` helper.
  - Delegated `NumberStmtWithMsg`, `StringArrayStmt`, and `NamingIdentifierCase` to `StmtCtx` (passing `ctx` and supporting `nil`-fn skip) and delegated `IndexTotalNumberLimit` to `SchemaBatch`.

  - Added `V1Stmt.Start`, `PosStmtStart`, `PosStatement`, `ExplainProbe`, `runProbes`, `V1RowLimitConfig.ExceededPrefix`, and `V1DMLDryRunConfig.StatementText`.

- **MySQL-family builder (`v1review_mysql_family.go`):**

body:
## Summary
Final consolidation and dead-code pruning pass strictly under `backend/plugin/parser/` (zero `go.mod` or non-parser edits): unifies the remaining hand-written split/range/parse/diagnose loops onto existing `parser/base` helpers and removes unreferenced helpers left over from recent omni cutovers (`#22166`, `#22168`, `#22186`, `#22194`, `#22195`, `#22198`).

### Net Line Reduction
- **Total (`backend/plugin/parser/`)**: **-1,218 net lines** (`+138 / -1,356` across 55 files)
- **Non-test production Go**: **-873 net lines** (`+87 / -960` across 43 files)
  - `parser/base`: **-290 net lines** (`+2 / -292`)
  - `googlesql/googlesqltest`: **-69 net lines** (`+2 / -71`)
  - Engine packages (18 packages): **-514 net lines** (`+83 / -597`)
- **Test Go**: **-345 net lines** (`+51 / -396` across 12 files, with edge cases from `tidb/ast_test.go` consolidated into `base/position_test.go` and full seam coverage preserved)

### 1. Unified Splitters, Ranges & Adapters onto `parser/base`

title: chore: bump omni to keep empty Split segments
body:
## Summary

Bumps `github.com/bytebase/omni` to `cd392f48efa6` (omni main). The new commits change `Split` for oracle, trino, googlesql, snowflake, oceanbase and cassandra (bytebase/omni#1646–#1651) to return segments that hold no statement, such as a lone `;` or a comment, marked empty instead of dropping them. The mysql, mariadb, tidb, doris and starrocks equivalents were already in the previous pin.

The splitter adapters already pass the flag through to `base.Statement.Empty`, and `GetQuerySpan`, `hasMultipleStatements`, the MCP clamp and AI review already skip empties. Changes:

- **plsql, googlesql**: `ParseStatements` now uses `ParseNonEmptyMultiNodeStatements`. With `ParseMultiNodeStatements`, every empty segment added an entry. For GoogleSQL that entry was a nil-node AST, so `INSERT ...;;\n-- done` would have classified as `INSERT, UNSPECIFIED, UNSPECIFIED`. A new case in `TestStatementTypeSeam` covers this and fails without the fix. For Oracle, it was an AST-less entry, which made `TestParseStatementsSeam` fail.
- **cassandra**: removes the `isCommentOnly` workaround, because omni's `Segment.Empty` now reports comment-only segments. The split seam test now asserts that lone `;`, comment-only and trailing `//` segments are marked empty.

## Audit

- Drivers for the bumped engines delegate statement splitting to omni drivers, which those omni PRs updated. `db/oracle`'s `withoutSQLPlusCommands` only picks `SegmentSQLPlusCommand` segments, and empties never have that kind. `db/cassandra` `QueryConn` already skips `Empty`.
- Snowflake goes through `analysis.SplitStatements`, which still skips empties, so nothing changes for Snowflake.
- Trino's `ParseSegmentedStatements` already gives empties no AST, and `ExtractASTs` drops them. No Trino advisors exist.
- Probed Oracle segments (`/`, SQL*Plus commands, trailing comments, `;;;`): every non-empty segment parses to at least one AST, so `ParseNonEmpty` drops only empties.
- The extra omni commits (snowflake/trino/oceanbase/oracle completion and analysis, bigquery and spanner driver) change no API that Bytebase calls.

## Test plan

- `go build ./backend/...` and the server build
- `golangci-lint` v2.15.0: 0 issues
- `go test ./backend/plugin/parser/... ./backend/plugin/advisor/... ./backend/plugin/schema/... ./backend/plugin/db/... ./backend/api/v1/...`: all pass

title: refactor(schema): consolidate SDL drop-advice and walk-through adapter helpers
body:
## Summary

Tightens `backend/plugin/schema/` toward a minimal adapter layer while preserving 100% of Bytebase-owned product behavior, shims, and seam coverage:

- **Shared SDL drop-advice helpers (`internal/omnicatalog/sdl.go`)**: Extracted `PlanSDLDropAdvices`, `SDLDropAdvice`, and `SDLReplaceAdvice`, removing duplicated advice builders and `MetadataToSDL` -> plan scaffolding from `mysql/sdl_migration.go` and `pg/sdl_migration.go`. Replaced repetitive per-op MySQL drop/replace switches and `nameSet` boilerplate with compact table-driven maps (`opNameKey`, `mysqlTableDropMessages`, `mysqlDropToCreate`, `mysqlReplaceLabels`), removed the test-only `mysqlDiffSDLMigration` wrapper, and added explicit MySQL view/function drop-vs-replace coverage in `mysql/sdl_migration_test.go`.
- **Walk-through adapter cleanup (`internal/omnicatalog/walk_through.go`, `{mysql,mariadb,oceanbase,tidb,pg}/walk_through.go`)**: Added `omnicatalog.InspectAST` to deduplicate `inspect*AST` across MySQL, MariaDB, and OceanBase; reused `omnicatalog.DDLSimulationAdvice` in `pg/walk_through.go`; removed unused `IsCTAS` wiring on `tidbWalkThroughEngine` (unreachable with nil `SplitSQL`); deduplicated warning-advice construction, removed dead `default`-identical error cases, and unexported `omnicatalog`-internal walk-through helpers.

+	engine storepb.Engine,
+	userSDLText string,
+	currentSchema *model.DatabaseMetadata,

Prunes all zero-caller engine testcontainer helpers, shared wrappers, and constants from `backend/common/testcontainer/` now that container-backed driver conformance tests for Oracle, MSSQL, CosmosDB, Trino, MongoDB, TiDB, Cassandra, ClickHouse, Hive, Redis, MySQL, and MariaDB have moved to `bytebase/omni` (#22169, #22174, #22177, #22182, #22189), and runs `go mod tidy`.

### Removed from `backend/common/testcontainer/`
- **`shared.go`** (+7 / -146, net -139): removed `SharedPg17Container`, `NewPg17Database`, `SharedTrinoContainer`, `SharedMSSQLContainer`, `SharedTiDBContainer`, `NewTiDBDatabase`, `SharedMongoDBContainer`, `NewMongoDatabase`, `SharedOracleContainer`, `NewOracleSchema`, `SharedMySQLContainer`, `NewMySQLDatabase`, `SharedMariaDBContainer`, `NewMariaDBDatabase`, `SharedRedisClusterContainer`, `SharedCassandraContainer`, `SharedClickHouseContainer`, `SharedHiveContainer`, `SharedCosmosContainer`, `createMySQLProtocolDatabase`, and their corresponding `shared*` package vars.

Simplified `pgRequest()` and `createTLSMaterial()` to match their sole remaining PostgreSQL 16 / TLS PostgreSQL callers.

### Retained active helpers

### `go.mod` tidy (+2 / -2)
- Demoted `github.com/sijms/go-ora/v2 v2.9.0` and `github.com/moby/moby/api v1.56.1` from direct to `// indirect` with no dependency version changes.

## Summary
- Bump `github.com/bytebase/omni` to `80f96377c33a` (includes `bytebase/omni#1642`, plus audited upstream commits `#1631`, `#1637`, `#1639`, `#1640`, `#1641`).

- Remove Bytebase's hand-rolled MySQL SQL lexer (`isMySQLCreateTableAsStatement`, `mySQLStatementTokens`, `skipMySQLQuotedText`, `skipMySQLLineComment`, `skipMySQLBlockComment`, `isMySQLIdentifierChar`) from `backend/plugin/schema/internal/omnicatalog/walk_through.go`, wiring `WalkThroughEngine.IsCTAS` directly to omni's lexer-backed `IsCreateTableAs` across `mysql`, `mariadb`, `oceanbase`, and `tidb`.

+func OmniStatementType(t omnianalysis.StatementType) storepb.StatementType {
+	return omniStatementTypeMap[t]

+// OmniStatementTypes converts a slice of omni statement types, omitting entries
+// that map to storepb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED.
+func OmniStatementTypes(types []omnianalysis.StatementType) []storepb.StatementType {
+	var result []storepb.StatementType

title: refactor(parser): consolidate duplicated query_span, resource_change, and parse adapter boilerplate into parser/base
body:
## Summary
Consolidates remaining duplicated non-test adapter boilerplate across 16 engine packages under `backend/plugin/parser/` into shared helpers in `backend/plugin/parser/base/`, preserving exact per-engine semantics and error messages.

### Net Line Reduction
- **Non-test production Go (`backend/plugin/parser/`)**: **-502 lines** (`+505 / -1007` across 57 files; **-742 net lines** across the 16 engine packages, `+240 net lines` in `parser/base`)
- **Unit tests added (`parser/base`)**: `+197` lines covering every new helper
- **Note on `go.mod`**: Includes a 1-line `go mod tidy` fix marking `github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb` as `// indirect` (leftover on `main` after #22189) so CI's `Verify go.mod is tidy` passes.

### Extracted `parser/base` Helpers
- `base/span_helpers.go`: `OmniResolvedSpanResult`, `OmniQuerySpan`, `OmniTableQuerySpan`, `RequireDatabaseMetadata`, `QuerySpanListDatabasesFunc`, `QuerySpanDatabaseGetter`, `QuerySpanProtoMetadataFunc`, `UnnamedSchemaQuerySpanCatalog`
- `base/resource_change.go`: `ExtractTypedChangedResources`
- `base/parse_helpers.go`: `ParseNonEmptyMultiNodeStatements`, `ConvertSyntaxError`, `FormatLineColSyntaxError`, `FormatLineSyntaxError`
- `base/explain.go`: `ExplainStatementResult`
- `base/limit.go`: `RewriteResultLimit`
- `base/mysql_complete.go`: reused `CompareCandidate`

### Per-Engine Non-Test Reductions
| Package | Added | Deleted | Net |
|---------|------:|--------:|----:|
| `mysql` | +27 | -118 | **-91** |
| `mariadb` | +26 | -117 | **-91** |

| **Total non-test** | **+505** | **-1007** | **-502** |

## Verification
- `gofmt -w` clean across all modified files
- `GOGC=off GOMEMLIMIT=10GiB golangci-lint run --fix -j 8 --allow-parallel-runners` and re-run without `--fix`: `0 issues.`

- `go build -ldflags "-w -s" -p=16 -o ./bytebase-build/bytebase ./backend/bin/server/main.go`: succeeded

title: refactor(db): adopt db/util adapter helpers across cassandra, hive, redis, and spanner
body:
## Summary

Completes 23/23 driver adapter consolidation following #22180 and #22188 by migrating the final 4 remaining drivers (`cassandra`, `hive`, `redis`, `spanner`) onto shared `backend/plugin/db/util` helpers while preserving all engine-specific behavior and keeping all existing engine tests unmodified.

### Shared `backend/plugin/db/util` additions (+41 prod, +62 test lines)
- `SetupSSHDialWithWrap`: opens an SSH tunnel via `SetupSSHDial` and wraps each dialed `net.Conn` with a driver-specific wrapper (used by `cassandra` for `tunnelConn` `*net.TCPAddr` RemoteAddr and `redis` for `util.NoDeadlineConn`).
- `StaticHostTLSFunc`: eagerly resolves TLS material via `GetTLSConfig` and returns a `driver.Config.TLS` callback that clones the config with `ServerName` bound to each dialed host (used by `spanner`).
- Unit test coverage in `backend/plugin/db/util/config_test.go` (`TestStaticHostTLSFunc`, `TestSetupSSHDialWithWrap`).

title: feat(ai): cache Claude prompts with cache breakpoints (BYT-10570)
body:
## Problem

Claude caches a prompt only when the request carries a `cache_control` breakpoint. The Claude adapter sent none, so every call paid the full input price for text Claude had just read. An AI SQL review is a loop of calls, and each call resends the tools, the system prompt, and every earlier turn.

The other providers cache a repeated prompt start without a request field, so only Claude was affected. The live check is under Other providers below. [BYT-10570](https://linear.app/bytebase/issue/BYT-10570)

## Change

All of it is in `backend/plugin/ai/claude.go`. No caller changes.

- **System prompt.** It is sent as one text block that ends with a breakpoint. Claude renders tools before the system prompt, so the breakpoint covers both. Requests that share them read them from the cache whatever their messages are.
- **Conversation.** The last block of the last message takes a breakpoint when the request has tools or earlier turns. The next call of the loop then reads everything this call sent.
- **One-shot calls.** A lone message with no tools is sent once and takes no breakpoint, because a cache write costs 1.25 times the input price. Release lint sends the same bytes as before.
- **Blank text.** A blank block takes no breakpoint, which Claude would reject.

The usage path is unchanged. It already adds cache writes and reads into the input total and reports the reads as `cached_input_tokens`.

## Before and after

Five reviews of one change, one after another, on `claude-sonnet-5-5`, with the raw `usage` of every Claude call recorded. Each side starts with a cold cache. `main` is `8752dc8f71`.

| 15 calls | `main` | This branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Input tokens at full price | 58,854 | 40 |
| Input tokens written to the cache | 0 | 8,702 |
| Input tokens read from the cache (`cached_input_tokens`) | 0 | 50,280 |
| Input cost at Sonnet 5.5 prices | $0.1177 | $0.0269 |
| Wall time | 35.7 s | 36.6 s |

Input cost falls 77%. The first review pays to write the system prompt and costs 52% less. Each later review reads it and costs 84% less. The time does not change at this prompt size.

The first two reviews, call by call:

| Review | Call | `main` full price | Branch full price | Branch written | Branch read |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | 3,586 | 4 | 3,598 | 0 |
| 1 | 2 | 4,032 | 2 | 448 | 3,598 |
| 1 | 3 | 4,196 | 2 | 164 | 4,046 |
| 2 | 1 | 3,562 | 4 | 503 | 3,063 |
| 2 | 2 | 4,008 | 2 | 448 | 3,566 |
| 2 | 3 | 4,172 | 2 | 164 | 4,014 |

Review 2 starts with 3,063 tokens read: the tools and the system prompt that review 1 stored.

## Tests

- `backend/plugin/ai/claude_test.go`: `TestChatClaudeCacheBreakpoints` covers a lone message, a system prompt, a first call with tools, a running tool loop, a correction round without tools, and blank text.
- `backend/plugin/aireview/model_ai_claude_test.go`: the review loop through the real adapter marks the system prompt and moves the conversation breakpoint to the last tool result

title: refactor(db): adopt db/util adapter helpers across bigquery, databricks, mongodb, mssql, oracle, and redshift
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #22180 (now that #22169 has merged): consolidates remaining duplicated non-test adapter boilerplate across the 6 drivers skipped during #22180 (`bigquery`, `databricks`, `mongodb`, `mssql`, `oracle`, `redshift`) onto `backend/plugin/db/util` without altering any engine-specific behavior.

### Shared `backend/plugin/db/util` additions (+62 / -6 prod, +88 test lines)
- `AdapterOptions.EagerSession` in `(*OmniAdapter).OpenWith`: opens and retains a query session during `OpenWith`, closing the driver and auxiliary closers on session-open failure.
- `(*OmniAdapter).QueryHeldConn` & `(*OmniAdapter).QueryEphemeralConn`: run a held/ephemeral session query and convert results via `OmniResultsToQueryResultsWith`.
- `OmniQueryOptions(queryContext, includeSchema, explainFormat)`: shared `db.QueryContext` → `omnidriver.QueryOptions` mapping (also reused by `MySQLForkQueryOptions`).
- Unit test coverage in `backend/plugin/db/util/{adapter,omnidriver}_test.go`.

### Per-driver consolidations (12 non-test files: +140 / -482, net -342 lines)
- **bigquery**: adopt `OpenWith` (`EagerSession: true`) and `QueryHeldConn` + `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve `SyncInstance` dataset-only output and `bigQueryConfig`.
- **databricks**: adopt `OpenWith` (`EagerSession: true`) and `QueryHeldConn` + `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve `databricksConfig` and `Execute` directive stripping.
- **mongodb**: adopt `OpenWith` and `QueryEphemeralConn` + `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve host/SRV/TLS config and BYT-9950 `Execute` logging.
- **mssql**: adopt `OpenWith` (with `AddCloseFunc` CA temp-file cleanup) and `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve partial-result return on `QueryConn` error, `ExplainFormat` (`TEXT`/`XML`), and Azure SQL token provider.
- **oracle**: adopt `OpenWith`, `QueryHeldConn`, and `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve `getTLSConfig`, `connectionParams`, SQL*Plus command blanking, `WrapOpenError`, `ProbeOmni`, and `OwnsPrivateDatabaseLink`.
- **redshift**: adopt `OpenWith`, `QueryHeldConn`, and `OmniQueryOptions`; preserve client-cert-only TLS behavior, `ParamDatashare`, no-op `Dump`, and `ExecuteScript`.

### Net Line Reduction
- **Non-test Go (14 files)**: +202 / -488 (**-286 net lines**)
- **Total (16 files, including `db/util` unit tests)**: +290 / -488 (**-198 net lines**)

--- backend/plugin/db/bigquery/bigquery.go (+17/-55)
@@ -1,38 +1,12 @@
-// Package bigquery is Bytebase's BigQuery driver: an adapter over
-// github.com/bytebase/omni/bigquery/driver that maps Bytebase's connection
-// config onto the driver contract and the contract's results back into the
-// product's protos. The job conversation, the statement split, the result
-// decode, the value mapping, the dataset sync queries and the dry run belong to
-// the omni driver.
+// Package bigquery is Bytebase's BigQuery driver, adapting
+// github.com/bytebase/omni/bigquery/driver to Bytebase's db.Driver interface.
 //
-// The mapping the adapter owns:
-//
-//   - The Google Cloud project is the data source's project ID, passed as
-//     driver.Config.Params["project"]. The dataset is the database the driver
-//     was opened on, which every statement's job defaults to and SyncDBSchema
-//     reads.
-//   - The credential is the data source's GCP credential JSON. A caller that
-//     resolved one itself passes it as Config.Password, and that one wins.
-//     Empty leaves the Google authentication library's default chain, which is
-//     what the previous driver did with no credential.
-//   - Config.Host and Config.Port are the endpoint override, for a Private
-//     Service Connect endpoint or a proxy. TLS and Dial are not set: the client
-//     library owns its transport and holds no dialer, so a tunnelled data

title: chore(review): name the reviews AI SQL review and rule-based SQL review
body:
## Summary

The product showed "AI review" beside "SQL review", which reads as if the AI review were not a SQL review. This PR renames them to **AI SQL review** and **Rule-based SQL review**. The first matches the existing "AI SQL review" plan feature.

| Where | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace and project SQL Review pages, AI section | AI review | AI SQL review |
| Review row, Activity and comment author beside V1 | AI review | AI SQL review |
| AI policy title | AI review policy | AI SQL review policy |
| Sentences naming it ("no AI review runs", "paused, so AI review…", project description, standard-rules hint) | AI review | AI SQL review |
| Plan check type (Checks drawer, the row beside the AI review) | SQL review | Rule-based SQL review |
| Workspace policy list title | SQL review policies | Rule-based SQL review policies |
| Plan feature `FEATURE_PRE_DEPLOYMENT_SQL_REVIEW` | SQL review | Rule-based SQL review |

Every locale (en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES, vi-VN) is updated. In zh-CN, "AI 审核" stays where it is a verb rather than the review's name ("使用 AI 审核变更").

Unchanged:
- The SQL Review page and menu, which cover both reviews.
- V2's reviewer name.
- Nouns inside the V1 policy flows, such as "Delete SQL review policy" and the "SQL review policy" default display name, which is stored data.
- "Enforce SQL review" in project settings.
- API error messages.

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm fix`: no changes
- [x] `pnpm test`: 822/822 files passed
- [x] E2E build (V1), checked with a temporary Playwright spec that was not committed:
  - The workspace SQL Review page shows "Rule-based SQL review policies" and "AI SQL review", with "AI is off for the workspace, so no AI SQL review runs."
  - The project SQL Review page shows "AI SQL review".
  - On a plan with a WARNING-level V1 rule, the Checks drawer names the result "Rule-based SQL review".
- [ ] Not checked in a browser with AI on (the review row, Activity and comment author): the harness has no AI model. These use the same `sql-review.ai-review.self` key shown above.

title: refactor(parser,schema): adopt omni T-SQL split, per-engine ValidateQuery, and MySQL-family walk-through classifiers
body:
## Summary

Bumps `github.com/bytebase/omni` from `eedd3d2249a7` to `e5dc3f282cbd` and adopts the new omni foundation APIs (`omni#1555`, `omni#1559`, `omni#1560`, `omni#1565`, `omni#1566`) to retire the remaining legacy parser and walk-through boilerplate (**-1,458 net lines** across 25 files):

1. **Retire `backend/plugin/parser/tokenizer/` (`-502` lines):**
   - Delegate `backend/plugin/parser/tsql/split.go` directly to `omni/mssql.Split` (preserving contiguous byte ranges, 1-based line/column positions, `Empty` flags for `GO` / empty segments, and lexical fallback on syntax errors).
   - Delete `backend/plugin/parser/tokenizer/tokenizer.go` after confirming zero remaining imports.

2. **Wire per-engine AST/parser-backed `ValidateQuery` & retire `base/split_test_runner.go` (`-479` lines in deleted test harness/fixtures):**
   - `CLICKHOUSE` -> `omni/clickhouse/analysis.ValidateQuery` (`parser/standard/query.go`)
   - `HIVE` -> `omni/hive/analysis.ValidateQuery` (`parser/standard/query.go`)
   - `BIGQUERY` -> `omni/googlesql/analysis.ValidateQuery(..., DialectBigQuery)` (`parser/googlesql/register.go`)
   - `SPANNER` -> `omni/googlesql/analysis.ValidateQuery(..., DialectSpanner)` (`parser/googlesql/register.go`)
   - `CASSANDRA` -> `omni/cassandra/analysis.ValidateQuery` (`parser/cassandra/query.go`)
   - `DATABRICKS` intentionally keeps its existing unregistered query-validator status (pinned by `TestMCPClampRefusesEngineItCannotClassify`).
   - Remove dead `standard.ValidateSQLForEditor` and `standard.CheckStatementWithoutQuotedTextAndComment` (zero external callers).
   - Replace `parser/standard/{split,explain,query}_test.go` with focused seam tests, add seam tests in `parser/{bigquery,spanner}/query_test.go` and `parser/cassandra/cassandra_test.go`, and delete `backend/plugin/parser/base/split_test_runner.go` and `backend/plugin/parser/standard/test-data/test_split.yaml`.

3. **Adopt `ClassifyWalkThroughStatement` across MySQL-family `schema/*/walk_through.go` (`-400+` lines):**
   - Switch `backend/plugin/schema/internal/omnicatalog/walk_through.go` from duplicate `StatementInfo`/`StatementKind`/`TableRef`/`RenamePair` types to `omni/analysis.WalkThroughStatement` and friends.

title: refactor(parser): consolidate remaining engine parser adapter boilerplate into parser/base
body:
## Summary

Consolidates remaining duplicated non-test parser adapter boilerplate across untouched engine packages into a new `backend/plugin/parser/base/parse_helpers.go` (with unit tests in `backend/plugin/parser/base/parse_helpers_test.go`), and removes the obsolete pre-omni `backend/plugin/parser/pg/SCENARIOS.md` completion checklist.

### Shared helpers added in `backend/plugin/parser/base/parse_helpers.go`
- `ParseSegmentedStatements` & `ParseNonEmptySegments` — shared split-and-parse loops with empty/whitespace segment handling, replacing duplicated per-engine loops in `doris`, `starrocks`, and `trino`.
- `ParseMultiNodeStatements` — shared split-and-expand loop for parsers returning `0..N` AST nodes per segment, used by `tidb` and `googlesql`.
- `ConvertParseError` — generic `errors.As` conversion from omni `*parser.ParseError` to `*base.SyntaxError` with shifted 1-based rune coordinates, replacing verbatim copies in `doris`, `starrocks`, and `trino`.
- `CollectSingleStatementTypesWithPosition` — shared typed-AST unwrap and optional `STATEMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED` filtering on top of `base.CollectStatementTypesWithPosition`, used by `mysql` and `redshift`.
- `BuildPathAST` — shared `SelectorNode` chain builder used by `cosmosdb` and `elasticsearch`.

### Per-engine adapter reductions
- `doris/doris.go`, `starrocks/starrocks.go`, `trino/trino.go`: adopt `ParseSegmentedStatements`, `ParseNonEmptySegments`, and `ConvertParseError`.
- `tidb/ast.go`: adopt `ParseMultiNodeStatements` (preserving all exported types/helpers and TiDB-specific line-only error position formatting).
- `mysql/statement_type.go`, `redshift/statement_type.go`: adopt `CollectSingleStatementTypesWithPosition` and replace verbose enum switches with lookup tables.
- `googlesql/statement_type.go`: adopt `ParseMultiNodeStatements` and replace the enum switch with a lookup table.
- `cosmosdb/query_span.go`, `elasticsearch/query_span.go`: adopt `BuildPathAST` and compact enum lookup tables in `elasticsearch`.
- `pg/SCENARIOS.md`: removed obsolete pre-omni PostgreSQL completion checklist (unreferenced repo-wide; PG completion moved to `omni/pg/completion`).

### Line delta
- Non-test Go: `+348 / -652` (**-304 net**)
- Unit tests (`parser/base/parse_helpers_test.go`): `+193 / -0`
- Obsolete doc (`parser/pg/SCENARIOS.md`): `+0 / -252`
- Total: `+541 / -904` (**-363 net**)

## Verification
- `gofmt -w` on all modified/added Go files
- `GOGC=off GOMEMLIMIT=10GiB golangci-lint run --fix -j 8 --allow-parallel-runners` and re-run without `--fix` (`0 issues`)
- `go test -count=1 ./backend/plugin/parser/{base,doris,starrocks,trino,tidb,mysql,googlesql,bigquery,spanner,redshift,cockroachdb,cosmosdb,elasticsearch,pg}/... ./backend/plugin/advisor/...` — all passed
- `go test -count=1 ./backend/api/v1/ -run '^TestGetStatementTypesWithPositionsForEngineMySQL$'` — passed
- `go build -ldflags "-w -s" -p=16 -o ./bytebase-build/bytebase ./backend/bin/server/main.go` — passed

--- backend/plugin/parser/base/parse_helpers.go (+149/-0)
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+package base
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"strings"
+
+	storepb "github.com/bytebase/bytebase/backend/generated-go/store"
+)
+
+// ParseSegmentedStatements splits statement and parses each non-empty segment into an AST.
+// Empty or whitespace-only segments are preserved as ParsedStatement entries with a nil AST.
+func ParseSegmentedStatements[A AST](
+	statement string,
+	split func(string) ([]Statement, error),
+	parseSegment func(Statement) (A, error),
+) ([]ParsedStatement, error) {
+	stmts, err := split(statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	result := make([]ParsedStatement, 0, len(stmts))
+	for _, stmt := range stmts {
+		ps := ParsedStatement{Statement: stmt}
+		if stmt.Empty || strings.TrimSpace(stmt.Text) == "" {
+			result = append(result, ps)
+			continue
+		}
+		parsed, err := parseSegment(stmt)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		ps.AST = parsed
+		result = append(result, ps)
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+
+// ParseNonEmptySegments splits statement and parses each non-empty segment, skipping empty or
+// whitespace-only segments.
+func ParseNonEmptySegments[A any](
+	statement string,
+	split func(string) ([]Statement, error),
+	parseSegment func(Statement) (A, error),
+) ([]A, error) {
+	stmts, err := split(statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	var result []A
+	for _, stmt := range stmts {
+		if stmt.Empty || strings.TrimSpace(stmt.Text) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		parsed, err := parseSegment(stmt)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		result = append(result, parsed)
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+
+// ParseMultiNodeStatements splits statement and expands each segment into zero or more
+// ParsedStatement entries. Segments producing no ASTs are preserved with a nil AST.
+func ParseMultiNodeStatements(
+	statement string,
+	split func(string) ([]Statement, error),
+	parseSegment func(Statement) ([]AST, error),
+) ([]ParsedStatement, error) {
+	stmts, err := split(statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if len(stmts) == 0 {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	result := make([]ParsedStatement, 0, len(stmts))
+	for _, stmt := range stmts {
+		asts, err := parseSegment(stmt)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if len(asts) == 0 {
+			result = append(result, ParsedStatement{Statement: stmt})
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, a := range asts {
+			result = append(result, ParsedStatement{Statement: stmt, AST: a})
+		}
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+
+// ConvertParseError converts an engine parse error matched via errors.As into a *SyntaxError
+// with 1-based line:column coordinates shifted by basePos. Returns err unchanged if it does
+// not match E.
+func ConvertParseError[E error](
+	statement string,
+	err error,
+	basePos *storepb.Position,
+	extract func(E) (byteOffset int, message, rawMessage string),
+) error {
+	var pe E
+	if !errors.As(err, &pe) {
+		return err
+	}
+	offset, msg, rawMsg := extract(pe)
+	return &SyntaxError{
+		Position:   ShiftPosition(ByteOffsetToRunePosition(statement, offset), basePos),
+		Message:    msg,
+		RawMessage: rawMsg,
+	}
+}
+
+// CollectSingleStatementTypesWithPosition classifies each AST into at most one StatementType
+// paired with its 1-based end line and SQL text. If includeUnspecified is false, statements
+// classifying as STATEMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED are omitted.
+func CollectSingleStatementTypesWithPosition[A AST](
+	asts []AST,
+	typeErr string,
+	includeUnspecified bool,
+	classify func(A) (storepb.StatementType, string, bool),
+) ([]StatementTypeWithPosition, error) {
+	return CollectStatementTypesWithPosition(asts, func(a AST) ([]storepb.StatementType, string, bool, error) {
+		wrapped, ok := a.(A)
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, "", false, errors.New(typeErr)
+		}
+		stmtType, text, ok := classify(wrapped)
+		if !ok || (!includeUnspecified && stmtType == storepb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED) {
+			return nil, "", false, nil
+		}
+		return []storepb.StatementType{stmtType}, text, true, nil
+	})
+}
+
+// BuildPathAST links nodes in order into a PathAST, returning nil when nodes is empty.
+func BuildPathAST(nodes []SelectorNode) *PathAST {
+	if len(nodes) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	pathAST := NewPathAST(nodes[0])
+	current := pathAST.Root
+	for _, next := range nodes[1:] {
+		current.SetNext(next)
+		current = next
+	}
+	return pathAST
+}

+package base
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/pkg/errors"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+

+)
+
+type stubNodeAST struct {
+	text  string
+	start *storepb.Position
+	kind  storepb.StatementType
+	valid bool
+}
+
+func (s *stubNodeAST) ASTStartPosition() *storepb.Position { return s.start }
+
+type otherStubAST struct{}
+
+func (otherStubAST) ASTStartPosition() *storepb.Position { return nil }
+
+type sampleParseErr struct {
+	pos int
+	msg string
+}
+
+func (e *sampleParseErr) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("parse error at %d: %s", e.pos, e.msg) }
+
+func TestParseSegmentedStatementsAndNonEmptySegments(t *testing.T) {
+	split := func(_ string) ([]Statement, error) {
+		return []Statement{
+			{Text: "SELECT 1;", Start: &storepb.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}},
+			{Text: "  ; ", Empty: true, Start: &storepb.Position{Line: 1, Column: 10}},
+			{Text: "   \n\t ", Start: &storepb.Position{Line: 1, Column: 14}},
+			{Text: "SELECT 2;", Start: &storepb.Position{Line: 2, Column: 1}},
+		}, nil
+	}
+	parseSeg := func(stmt Statement) (*stubNodeAST, error) {
+		return &stubNodeAST{text: stmt.Text, start: stmt.Start}, nil
+	}
+
+	parsed, err := ParseSegmentedStatements("ignored", split, parseSeg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, parsed, 4)
+	require.NotNil(t, parsed[0].AST)
+	require.Nil(t, parsed[1].AST)
+	require.Nil(t, parsed[2].AST)
+	require.NotNil(t, parsed[3].AST)
+	require.Equal(t, "SELECT 2;", parsed[3].AST.(*stubNodeAST).text)
+
+	nonEmpty, err := ParseNonEmptySegments("ignored", split, parseSeg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, nonEmpty, 2)
+	require.Equal(t, "SELECT 1;", nonEmpty[0].text)
+	require.Equal(t, "SELECT 2;", nonEmpty[1].text)
+
+	// Error propagation from split and parseSegment.
+	splitErr := errors.New("split failed")
+	_, err = ParseSegmentedStatements("x", func(string) ([]Statement, error) { return nil, splitErr }, parseSeg)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, splitErr)
+	_, err = ParseNonEmptySegments("x", func(string) ([]Statement, error) { return nil, splitErr }, parseSeg)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, splitErr)
+
+	parseErr := errors.New("parse failed")
+	failParse := func(Statement) (*stubNodeAST, error) { return nil, parseErr }
+	_, err = ParseSegmentedStatements("x", split, failParse)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, parseErr)
+	_, err = ParseNonEmptySegments("x", split, failParse)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, parseErr)
+}
+
+func TestParseMultiNodeStatements(t *testing.T) {
+	emptySplit := func(string) ([]Statement, error) { return nil, nil }
+	res, err := ParseMultiNodeStatements("", emptySplit, func(Statement) ([]AST, error) { return nil, nil })
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, res)
+
+	split := func(string) ([]Statement, error) {
+		return []Statement{
+			{Text: "-- comment", Empty: true},
+			{Text: "SELECT 1; SELECT 2;"},
+		}, nil
+	}
+	res, err = ParseMultiNodeStatements("input", split, func(stmt Statement) ([]AST, error) {
+		if stmt.Empty {
+			return nil, nil
+		}
+		return []AST{
+			&stubNodeAST{text: "first"},
+			&stubNodeAST{text: "second"},
+		}, nil
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, res, 3)
+	require.Nil(t, res[0].AST)
+	require.Equal(t, "first", res[1].AST.(*stubNodeAST).text)
+	require.Equal(t, "second", res[2].AST.(*stubNodeAST).text)
+
+	parseErr := errors.New("bad syntax")
+	_, err = ParseMultiNodeStatements("input", split, func(Statement) ([]AST, error) { return nil, parseErr })
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, parseErr)

+func TestConvertParseError(t *testing.T) {

body:
## Summary

Consolidates remaining duplicated non-test driver adapter boilerplate across 14 `backend/plugin/db/<engine>` packages into shared helpers in `backend/plugin/db/util` (building on #22156), while preserving exact engine behavior and passing all existing engine tests unmodified.

- **Total diff:** `+644 / -669` (`-25` net lines, including `+177` lines of unit tests in `backend/plugin/db/util/*_test.go`)
- **Non-test production Go:** `+467 / -669` (`-202` net lines: `-414` net lines across engine adapters vs `+212` net lines of shared helpers in `db/util`)

### Shared helpers added in `backend/plugin/db/util`
- **`adapter.go`**:
  - `AdapterOptions` + `(*OmniAdapter).OpenWith` — deduplicates the `opened := false; defer func() { if !opened { _ = d.Close(ctx) } }()` cleanup lifecycle across `clickhouse`, `cockroachdb`, `doris`, `elasticsearch`, `mysql`, `oceanbase`, `pg`, `starrocks`, and `tidb`.
  - `SessionQueryOptions.WrapOpenError` — replaces custom `d.Query(...)` closures wrapping `OpenSession` errors in `oceanbase`, `oracle`, and `trino` with `d.QueryHeldSession`.
  - `(*OmniAdapter).QueryEphemeralSession` — simplifies stateless ephemeral session queries in `cosmosdb`, `dynamodb`, and `elasticsearch`.
  - `BuildExecuteOptions` — extracted from `ExecuteScript` so adapters that keep an `executeOptions` helper (`cockroachdb`, `doris`, `starrocks`) share a single implementation.
- **`omnidriver.go`**:

## Summary
Consolidates duplicated non-test DML backup and restore adapter boilerplate across `mysql`, `mariadb`, `tidb`, `pg`, `plsql`, and `tsql` into typed helpers in `backend/plugin/parser/base/{backup,restore}.go`, preserving all exported symbols, logging, position semantics, and error messages.

### Shared helpers extracted into `backend/plugin/parser/base`
- **`base/backup.go`**:
  - `ConvertOffsetBackupStatements`: single-pass ascending byte-offset position mapping for `pg` (0-based start, 1-based end) and `plsql` (0-based start and end).
  - `BackupCatalogFuncs` & `SingleUnnamedSchemaGetter`: unnamed-schema catalog callbacks for `mysql`, `mariadb`, and `tidb`.
  - `NewColumnClassifier`: validates `GetDatabaseMetadataFunc`, delegates to engine `ClassifyColumns`, and translates `omni/analysis.ResourceNotFoundError` with Bytebase's debug log and error wording.
- **`base/restore.go`**:
  - `ValidateBackupItem`, `ParseBackupSourceDatabase`, `ParseBackupTargetDatabase`, `ParseBackupItemDatabases`
  - `ExtractSingleStatement` & `ExtractStatementOptions`: shared split/range/match/normalize/join extraction for `mysql`, `mariadb`, `tidb`, and `plsql`.
  - `ParseForRestore`, `PositionInRange`, `FilterDMLsInRange`, `StatementNotFoundError`: shared range-filtered DML extraction for `pg` and `tsql` (also avoids parsing the T-SQL script twice).
  - `CheckRestoreDMLs` & `ClassifyRestoreColumns`: shared DML validation and column classification for `mysql`, `mariadb`, and `tidb`.
  - `ResolveRestoreTableMetadata`: shared database/schema/table/PK metadata resolution for `pg`, `plsql`, and `tsql`.
  - `FormatRestoreComment`: shared 1000-character restore comment truncation for `pg`.
- **`base/backup_restore_test.go`**: unit tests for the new shared helpers.

## Summary
Consolidates remaining duplicated per-engine V1 advisor adapter boilerplate across PostgreSQL, Oracle, MSSQL, Snowflake, MySQL, MariaDB, OceanBase, and TiDB onto shared `V1Engine` builders and `advisor` helpers while preserving 100% V1 behavior and YAML fixture parity.

### Consolidated helpers & adapters
- **Shared `V1Engine` builders (`v1review_engine.go`, `v1review_helpers.go`, `prober.go`, `advisor.go`):**
  - Default `ByteOffsetLine` to `base.ByteOffsetToRunePosition(sql, offset).Line` when omitted across all 8 engines.
  - `PriorBackup` (`V1PriorBackupConfig`) + shared `renderPriorBackupFinding`: unifies `BUILTIN_PRIOR_BACKUP_CHECK` across MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MSSQL (and reuses `V1Engine` memoization for MySQL/MariaDB).
  - `ColumnRequired` (`V1ColumnRequiredConfig`): unifies grouped missing-column rendering across PostgreSQL, Oracle, and the MySQL family.
  - `NamingRule` & `NamingIdentifierCase`: unifies regex naming convention templates across all 8 engines and identifier case checks across Oracle and Snowflake.
  - `SchemaBatch` & `IndexTotalNumberLimit`: promotes MySQL-family schema batch / `ReadMissingSchema` handling onto `V1Engine` and shares `INDEX_TOTAL_NUMBER_LIMIT` with PostgreSQL.

body:
Completes the remaining non-unified engine pieces in `backend/plugin/advisor/`:

1. **Trim PostgreSQL SDL style & integrity tests to Bytebase advice-rendering seam tests** (after porting all uncovered engine-judgment cases to `bytebase/omni#1540`, merged in `9657ba248`):
   - `backend/plugin/advisor/pg/sdl_check_test.go` (492 -> 109 lines): covers empty/valid/syntax-error return contract, every `sdlStyleAdvice` code/title/content/line branch (including all 5 `tableConstraintExample` branches and both named/unnamed `SDLIndexWithoutSchema`), and `sdlStyleLine` `LF` vs `CR` line calculation.
   - `backend/plugin/advisor/pg/sdl_integrity_check_test.go` (554 -> 130 lines): covers `checkSingleStatement` valid/empty/`SDLSyntaxError` advice rendering (`StartPosition == nil`), all single-file `sdlIntegrityAdvice` branches (including table-scoped vs schema-scoped duplicate constraints, `<unnamed>` constraints, and `<none>`/`<no columns>` fallbacks), and `sdlFileLine` line calculation.
   - `backend/plugin/advisor/pg/sdl_integrity_check_multifile_test.go` (779 -> 163 lines): covers multi-file map routing (empty map, valid multi-file map, syntax error keyed to failing file only, cross-file duplicate routing) and deterministic formatting assertions for all 4 `*AcrossFiles` advice branches.

2. **Collapse `advisor/bigquery` and `advisor/redshift` onto `advisor.V1Engine` + `advisor.RegisterFunc`** (following `#22157`):
   - Replaced `backend/plugin/advisor/bigquery/{rule_where_require_update_delete.go,statement_finding_line.go}` with `backend/plugin/advisor/bigquery/rules.go` using `advisor.NewV1Engine` (`V1PosFindingOrFirstLine`) + `e.SimpleStmt`.
   - Replaced `backend/plugin/advisor/redshift/advisor_table_drop_naming_convention.go` with `backend/plugin/advisor/redshift/rules.go` using `advisor.NewV1Engine` + `e.NamingRegex` with `stmt.Start` position preservation.
   - Verified zero external references to the removed per-rule advisor structs; all existing YAML fixtures (`test/*.yaml`) are untouched and pass 100%.

+// Package bigquery implements the SQL advisor rules for BigQuery.
+package bigquery
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"

+	omniast "github.com/bytebase/omni/googlesql/ast"

+	"github.com/bytebase/bytebase/backend/plugin/parser/googlesql"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	extract := advisor.NodeExtractor(func(a base.AST) (omniast.Node, bool) {
+		ast, ok := a.(*googlesql.AST)
+		if !ok || ast.Node == nil {
+			return nil, false
+		}
+		return ast.Node, true
+	})
+	byteOffsetLine := func(sql string, offset int) int32 {
+		if offset <= 0 {
+			return 1
+		}
+		if offset > len(sql) {
+			offset = len(sql)
+		}
+		return int32(1 + strings.Count(sql[:offset], "\n"))

+			return fmt.Sprintf("WHERE clause is required for %s statement.", f.Name)
+		}))
+}

title: test(oracle,pg,mysql,tidb): relocate duplicated catalog golden corpora to omni
body:
Relocates duplicated engine-fidelity catalog golden YAML corpora and engine tests for `oracle`, `pg`, `mysql`, and `tidb` from `backend/plugin/schema/{oracle,pg,mysql,tidb}/` into `github.com/bytebase/omni/{oracle,pg,mysql,tidb}/catalog/` (merged in https://github.com/bytebase/omni/pull/1524), leaving concise Bytebase product-seam tests per `docs/design/engine-code-to-omni.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

Net change in Bytebase: **30 files changed, +768 / -33,533 lines (net -32,765 lines)**.

## Exact Per-File Coverage Mapping

| Bytebase File (Removed / Slimmed) | Cases | Coverage Disposition |
|---|---:|---|
| `oracle/testdata/generate_migration.yaml` | 35 | Already mirrored in `omni/oracle/catalog/testdata/generate_migration.yaml` (`TestGenerateMigration`, `TestMigrationReplay`) |
| `oracle/testdata/get_database_metadata.yaml` | 13 | Already mirrored in `omni/oracle/catalog/testdata/get_database_metadata.yaml` (`TestMetadataFromSQL`, `TestGetDatabaseMetadata`) |
| `oracle/testdata/get_database_definition.yaml` | 3 | Already mirrored in `omni/oracle/catalog/testdata/get_database_definition.yaml` (`TestDatabaseDefinition`, `TestDefinitionRoundTrip`, `TestDefinitionRunsOnOracle`) |
| `oracle/testdata/cutover_parity.yaml` + `oracle/cutover_parity_test.go` | 6 | All 6 cases covered in `omni/oracle/catalog/testdata/generate_migration.yaml`; Bytebase trailing-newline contract + `stripUnrenderedFacts` shims retained in `oracle/generate_migration_test.go` and `oracle/get_database_definition_test.go` |
| `oracle/get_database_definition_test.go` + `oracle/get_database_metadata_test.go` | 23 inline | Ported to `omni/oracle/catalog/object_definition_and_metadata_test.go` (`TestGetTableDefinition`, `TestGetObjectDefinition`, `TestGetDatabaseMetadataObjectKinds`, plus Oracle-backed tape `TestObjectDefinitionsRunOnOracle` in `bytebase/omni#1524`); Bytebase retains registry wiring, `SkipDump`, and `stripUnrenderedFacts` seam tests |
| `pg/testdata/get_database_definition.yaml` | 14 | Ported to `omni/pg/catalog/testdata/get_database_definition.yaml` (`TestDatabaseDefinitionCorpus` + Postgres-backed tape `TestDatabaseDefinitionCorpusRunsOnPostgres` in `bytebase/omni#1524`); Bytebase retains `SkipBackupSchema`, `PrintHeader`, CockroachDB routing, `parseQualifiedTypeIdent`, and `legacy_normalize_test.go` |
| `pg/testdata/cutover_parity.yaml` | 92 | Ported to `omni/pg/catalog/testdata/metadata_migration.yaml` (`TestMetadataMigrationCorpus` in `bytebase/omni#1524`); Bytebase retains `TestDiffMigrationRouting`, `TestDiffMigrationSeamOptions`, and entry-point smoke tests in `pg/metadata_migration_test.go` |
| `pg/testdata/walk_through.yaml` | 4 | Covered in `omni/pg/catalog/` (`metadata_apply_test.go`, `TestWalkThroughQuotedIndexDrop`, `dryrun_validation_test.go`); Bytebase retains `TestWalkThroughSeam`, `TestWalkThroughSearchPathState`, `TestClone_SearchPath`, `TestClone_WalkThroughFunction`, and `TestWalkThroughOwnerChangeAndWrapperPreservation` |
| `mysql/testdata/get_databas

title: test(db): retire post-cutover differential parity scaffolding across 9 drivers

## Summary
Per `docs/design/engine-code-to-omni.md` ("Testing"), the differential parity corpora gated each driver's cutover onto `github.com/bytebase/omni/<engine>/driver`; after cutover, engine-level conformance lives in `omni/<engine>/driver` while Bytebase retains focused seam tests for adapter config mapping, session lifecycle, directives, result/error conversion, and engine dispatch.

This PR retires the 18 post-cutover differential parity files (~397 KB) plus the now-unused `backend/plugin/db/redshift/main_test.go`, cleans up stale `cutover_parity_test.go` package comments, and preserves/adds focused Bytebase adapter seam tests so no adapter-side or engine-side invariant loses coverage.

### Phase 1 (`bytebase/omni`)
- Audited all 9 engines against `omni/<engine>/driver/*_test.go` and `testdata/tapes/`.
- Found and closed the single uncovered engine conformance path (`CountAffectedRows` falling back from `EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON` to `EXPLAIN FORMAT=TRADITIONAL` and `explain_json_format_version` reset/1193 handling) in bytebase/omni#1527 (merged).

### Per-Engine Coverage Mapping

+				Truncated: true,

+		},

+	require.Equal(t, 3, fake.execOpts.MaxRetries)

+	require.Nil(t, instance.Metadata)

-// These pins cover masking-leak shapes that CANNOT live in the legacy-recorded
-// differential corpus (test-data/query-span/standard.yaml), because the legacy
-// ANTLR resolver either errors on them (fail-closed) or produces lineage that is
-// itself a known leak. For each, omni must produce CORRECT lineage — the
-// structural rule for shapes legacy cannot resolve: correct lineage or a closed
-// failure, never silently empty/misaligned attribution (bytebase's masker is
-// positional and fail-open).
-
-func leakPinSpan(t *testing.T, statement string, tables []*metadatapb.TableMetadata) []base.QuerySpanResult {
-	t.Helper()
-	span, err := googlesqltest.GetSpan(t, storepb.Engine_BIGQUERY, GetQuerySpan, statement, "ds1",
-		googlesqltest.DefaultSchemaTables(tables...))
-	require.NoError(t, err, "statement: %s", statement)
-	return span.Results
-}
-
-// TestLeakPin_LowercaseUsingCoalesce: `SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING (k)` with a
-// lowercase key. Real BigQuery coalesces USING keys case-insensitively (3 output
-// columns), but the LEGACY resolver only coalesced upper-case-written keys — its
-// lowercase output was 4 uncoalesced columns, shifting every later position
-// against the executed result (a masking leak legacy shipped with). omni
-// coalesces case-insensitively: one key column whose lineage reads BOTH sides,
-// then the non-key columns, positionally aligned with the real output.
-func TestLeakPin_LowercaseUsingCoalesce(t *testing.T) {
-	results := leakPinSpan(t, "SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING (k);", []*metadatapb.TableMetadata{
-		{Name: "a", Columns: []*metadatapb.ColumnMetadata{{Name: "k"}, {Name: "x"}}},
-		{Name: "b", Columns: []*metadatapb.ColumnMetadata{{Name: "k"}, {Name: "y"}}},

-	require.Equal(t, []string{"a.x"}, googlesqltest.SourcesOf(results[1]))
-	require.Equal(t, []string{"b.y"}, googlesqltest.SourcesOf(results[2]))
-}
-
-// TestLeakPin_UnnestLineage: `SELECT elem FROM victim, UNNEST(victim.secret_tokens)
-// AS elem` — the UNNEST output column's lineage is the unnested array column. The
-// legacy resolver ERRORED on UNNEST in FROM (fail-closed); omni resolves it, so it
-// must attribute correctly — silently-empty lineage would return the sensitive
-// array elements unmasked.
-func TestLeakPin_UnnestLineage(t *testing.T) {
-	results := leakPinSpan(t, "SELECT elem FROM victim, UNNEST(victim.secret_tokens) AS elem", []*metadatapb.TableMetadata{

-		"UNNEST element column must carry the array column's lineage")
-}
-
-// TestLeakPin_UnnestWithOffsetNoLineage: the WITH OFFSET companion column is
-// positional metadata, not data — empty lineage is correct for it, while the
-// element column keeps the array lineage.
-func TestLeakPin_UnnestWithOffsetNoLineage(t *testing.T) {
-	results := leakPinSpan(t, "SELECT elem, pos FROM victim, UNNEST(victim.secret_tokens) AS elem WITH OFFSET AS pos", []*metadatapb.TableMetadata{
-		{Name: "victim", Columns: []*metadatapb.ColumnMetadata{{Name: "id"}, {Name: "secret_tokens"}}},
-	})

-	require.Equal(t, []string{"victim.secret_tokens"}, googlesqltest.SourcesOf(results[0]))
-	require.Empty(t, googlesqltest.SourcesOf(results[1]), "OFFSET is positional, carries no data lineage")
-}
-
-// TestLeakPin_ByNameMerge: `UNION ALL BY NAME` aligns set-op arms by column NAME,
-// not ordinal. The legacy parser syntax-errors on BY NAME (fail-closed); omni
-// parses it, so the analysis must name-merge — an ordinal merge would attribute

-// pre-fix: ID <- rt.b_secret).
-func TestLeakPin_ByNameMerge(t *testing.T) {

-		{Name: "rt", Columns: []*metadatapb.ColumnMetadata{{Name: "id"}, {Name: "b_secret"}}},

title: refactor(parser): adopt omni/analysis shared contract and CompleteSession
body:
## Summary
Adopts two capabilities already pinned in `github.com/bytebase/omni` (`v0.0.0-20261121152614-bad274d8b403`, no `go.mod`/`go.sum` changes):

1. **`github.com/bytebase/omni/analysis` shared contract (`omni#1507`):**
   - Replaced generic per-field closure converters in `backend/plugin/parser/base/{span_helpers.go,resource_change.go,position.go,explain.go}` with direct `omni/analysis` converters (`OmniQueryType`, `OmniColumnResource`, `OmniColumnSet`, `OmniQuerySpanResults`, `OmniResolvedSpan`, `OmniResourceNotFoundError`, `OmniNotFoundError`, `ToOmniNotFoundError`, `OmniFunctionNotSupportedError`, `OmniTypeNotSupportedError`, `OmniUnresolvedColumnsError`, `ConvertOmniMixTablesError`, `OmniExplainAnalyzeError`, `OmniStatements`, `MapByteRangesToLSP`, and `omnianalysis.StatementChanges` directly in `AppendStatementChanges` / `ExtractChangedResourcesFromASTs`).
   - Removed duplicated per-engine span, error, resource-change, statement-range, and statement-split conversion boilerplate across `mysql`, `mariadb`, `oceanbase`, `tidb`, `pg`, `plsql`, `tsql`, `snowflake`, `redshift`, `trino`, `starrocks`, `doris`, `googlesql`, and `cassandra`.
   - Added unit test coverage for all new `omni/analysis` converters in `backend/plugin/parser/base/helpers_test.go`.

2. **Session-aware completion (`omni#1510`):**
   - Delegated `plsql`, `tsql`, `pg` (preserving `POSTGRES`, `SNOWFLAKE`, and `COCKROACHDB` registrations), `redshift`, and `trino` completion to omni's `CompleteSession` / `SessionConfig` APIs using a shared `base.CompletionMetadataLoaders` helper.
   - Removed superseded SQL-level quoting, caret-in-quotes, Oracle `q`-quote, MSSQL bracket-quote, scene-filtering, statement-at-caret, and catalog-loading code from those 5 adapters, plus unused `base.CaretToByteOffset` and `base.StatementAtCaret`.

Net diff: **50 files changed, +617 / -1,894 lines (-1,277 net)**.

title: refactor(schema/mariadb,clickhouse): delegate MariaDB catalog ops and ClickHouse DDL deparse to omni
body:
## Summary
Closes the last two schema-engine gaps between `bytebase/bytebase` and `github.com/bytebase/omni` using [bytebase/omni#1505](https://github.com/bytebase/omni/pull/1505):

- **MariaDB (`backend/plugin/schema/mariadb/`):**
  - Replaced the MySQL-catalog fallback in `walk_through.go` with native `omni/mariadb/catalog` + `omni/mariadb/ast` via `omnicatalog.RunWalkThrough`, including sequence DDL (`CREATE/ALTER/DROP SEQUENCE`) prechecks.
  - Registered native `GetDatabaseDefinition`, `GetTableDefinition`, `GetViewDefinition`, `GetFunctionDefinition`, `GetProcedureDefinition`, `GetSequenceDefinition`, and `GetDatabaseMetadata` for `Engine_MARIADB` backed by `omni/mariadb/catalog` (using `omnicatalog.RegisterMySQLFamilyDefinitions` and `omnicatalog.ExtractSimpleDatabaseMetadata`).
  - Expanded walk-through, definition, and metadata unit tests to cover MariaDB-only DDL (`CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE`, `WITH SYSTEM VERSIONING`, `CREATE SEQUENCE`, `IGNORED` indexes, `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW`).
  - Updated `AGENTS.md` to remove the now-obsolete note about `schema/mariadb` simulating on MySQL.
- **ClickHouse (`backend/plugin/schema/clickhouse/`):**
  - Deleted Bytebase's last custom metadata-to-DDL deparser (`state.go`) and delegated `GetDatabaseDefinition`, `GetTableDefinition`, and `GetViewDefinition` to `github.com/bytebase/omni/clickhouse/deparse`.
  - Added `get_database_definition_test.go` covering registry dispatch, data-skipping indexes, sorting/primary keys, comments, and views.
  - Updated `backend/plugin/aireview/catalog_test.go` to reflect that ClickHouse's renderer now emits data-skipping indexes with granularity natively (`INDEX \`url_bloom\` url TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4`).

## `github.com/bytebase/omni` Pin Bump Audit (`e65970a350c8..eedd3d2249a7`)
- `12c53bdb5` `test(pg,oracle,mssql): pin query analysis corpora and engine suites in <engine>/analysis (#1519)` — ports analysis corpora and fixes `mssql/analysis/backup.go` (`TOP` placement and outer `OPTION` hoisting).
- `eedd3d224` `feat(mariadb,clickhouse): add MariaDB DatabaseMetadata and ClickHouse metadata deparse (#1505)` — adds `mariadb/catalog.(*Catalog).DatabaseMetadata` and `clickhouse/deparse`.

body:
## Summary
Consolidates remaining duplicated omni/driver adapter boilerplate across all 23 `backend/plugin/db/<engine>` packages into modular, tested shared building blocks in `backend/plugin/db/util` (building on #22151).

### Shared helpers added in `backend/plugin/db/util`
- `OmniAdapter` & `SessionHolder` ([adapter.go](backend/plugin/db/util/adapter.go)):
  - Lazy, mutex-serialized session management (`QueryHeldSession`, `SessionHolder.Query`, `Session`, `SetSession`, `Close`) with hooks for engine-specific error/cancellation retention (`KeepOnError` for Snowflake recoverable errors, `ShouldDiscardResults` for ClickHouse health check).
  - Ephemeral session runner (`QueryEphemeral`), `Ping`, `SyncInstance`, `SyncDBSchema` (with configurable `NotFoundResource` -> `common.NotFound` mapping), `Dump`, `Close` with auxiliary closer registration (`AddCloser` / `AddCloseFunc`), and `ExecuteScript` with per-engine `ExecuteConfig` (directives, isolation, `CreateDatabase`, `MaxRetries`, `DirectiveShift`, script preprocessing, logger options).
- Connection config & network/IAM helpers ([config.go](backend/plugin/db/util/config.go)):
  - `ResolveDatabaseName`, `ApplicationName`, `CloneParams`, `PositiveMaxResultBytes`, `ValidateTLSCertKeyPair`, `StaticTLSFunc`, `LazyTLSFunc`, `HostTLSFunc`, `SetupSSHDial`, `SetupCloudSQLDial`, and `ConfigureRDSMySQLIAM`.
- Live-review probe runner ([probe.go](backend/plugin/db/util/probe.go)):

+package omnicatalog
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	metadatapb "github.com/bytebase/omni/metadata"
+	"github.com/pkg/errors"
+)
+
+// ExtractDatabaseMetadata initializes an omni catalog with dbName, executes schemaText,
+// and exports the resulting DatabaseSchemaMetadata. When currentDB is non-nil, it
+// selects the database name to export (used by TiDB when schemaText selects its own
+// database via USE).
+func ExtractDatabaseMetadata[Catalog any](
+	schemaText string,
+	dbName string,
+	newCatalog func() *Catalog,
+	exec func(c *Catalog, sql string, continueOnError bool) ([]ExecResult, error),
+	currentDB func(c *Catalog) string,
+	export func(c *Catalog, dbName string) *metadatapb.DatabaseSchemaMetadata,
+) (*metadatapb.DatabaseSchemaMetadata, error) {
+	if strings.TrimSpace(schemaText) == "" {
+		return &metadatapb.DatabaseSchemaMetadata{}, nil
+	}
+
+	c := newCatalog()
+	initSQL := fmt.Sprintf("SET foreign_key_checks = 0;\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `%s`;\nUSE `%s`;", dbName, dbName)
+	if _, err := exec(c, initSQL, false); err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to initialize catalog")
+	}
+
+	results, err := exec(c, schemaText, true)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to parse schema DDL")
+	}
+	for _, r := range results {
+		if r.Error != nil {
+			return nil, errors.Wrap(r.Error, "failed to execute schema DDL")
+		}
+	}
+
+	targetDB := dbName
+	if currentDB != nil {
+		targetDB = currentDB(c)
+	}
+	return export(c, targetDB), nil
+}

title: feat(agent): unify API response handling and recovery guidance
body:
## Summary

Centralize post-API-call error handling so Agent operations and skills provide consistent, evidence-based recovery guidance without adding an entitlement preflight service.

- Classify permission denials, paid-feature requirements, instance activation requirements, and protocol errors, with a general fallback for unclassified failures.
- Migrate query recovery, typed skill readers, JIT eligibility errors, and recent activity to the shared handler.
- Preserve per-attempt unknown and partial effects while retiring resolved blockers. Keep preflight and client-error provenance distinct from observed API responses.
- Preserve exact approval, member consent, and no-replay safeguards; keep diagnostic guidance explanation-only.
- Add regression coverage and update stale browser fixtures for current storage, saved-chat selection, and portaled controls.

## Testing

- Frontend formatting and full gate passed: 14,657 tests.
- Targeted Chrome E2E passed: 50 workflow tests plus setup, covering query recovery, skills, approvals, denial, reload/no-replay, diagnostics, and SQL permissions.
- Provider responses were scripted; browser and tool execution paths were exercised.
- `git diff --cached --check` passed.

Test results are from the completed verification run before staging; tests were not rerun while drafting this description.
author: ecmadao
diff:
--- frontend/src/modules/agent/AGENTS.md (+24/-0)
@@ -32,6 +32,30 @@ Keep agent-only UI and state inside this module. Shared application primitives s
 - `dom_action` interacts with elements from the latest DOM snapshot.
 - `get_skill` loads workflow guidance from `logic/skills/`.
 
+### API response recovery
+
+`logic/apiResponse.ts` interprets observed failures, not entitlement preflight.
+Generic API dispatch and typed API error adapters use the same classifier.
+Paid-feature advice requires an explicit recognized backend error; a 403 or
+unavailable overview alone is not subscription evidence. Typed readers that need
+recovery guidance should use `agentApiErrorResult` before losing their Connect
+error details. Keep intentional unavailable facets local.
+
+Typed failures keep fallback text and protocol code in `apiError`, not fabricated
+HTTP status, raw diagnostic prose, or unrelated details. Client errors do not prove
+that a server responded or a request was dispatched. Local validation and target
+clarification stay domain-owned. `apiResponseGuidance.ts` supplies a common fallback
+plus protocol-specific advice only for API failures or validated uncertain execution.
+Execution metadata must satisfy the shared envelope validator before specialized
+advice. A later matching request cannot resolve an earlier attempt's possible or
+partial effects. Shared safety rules cover all prompt modes; diagnostic advice stays
+explanation-only and never starts query access, drafts, retries, or operational
+approval workflows.
+
+Current-turn recovery guidance reuses the existing query Access Grant workflow,
+including fresh eligibility and member consent. Recovery metadata never authorizes
+an action, changes execution evidence, proves rollback, or permits automatic retry.
+
 DOM refs such as `e1` are local to one `get_page_state(mode="dom")` snapshot. Refresh the snapshot after navigation or any DOM-changing action; never describe refs as durable identifiers.

body:
Delegate the remaining Bytebase-side DDL metadata extraction and single-table rendering in `backend/plugin/schema/oracle` and `backend/plugin/schema/mssql` to `github.com/bytebase/omni` (`a2a601d5d248`, merged in https://github.com/bytebase/omni/pull/1492).

## Summary

- **Bump `github.com/bytebase/omni`** to `v0.0.0-20261120162521-a2a601d5d248`.
- **Oracle (`backend/plugin/schema/oracle`)**:
  - Delegate `GetDatabaseMetadata` in `oracle.go` to `omni/oracle/catalog.GetDatabaseMetadata`.
  - Delete `get_database_metadata.go` (913 lines) and `metadata_helpers.go` (133 lines).
  - Update `get_database_metadata_test.go` and `testdata/get_database_metadata.yaml` for `omni/oracle/catalog`'s fixes (preserved expression spacing, untyped virtual columns staying untyped, non-doubled `NVARCHAR2`/`NCHAR` lengths, view `dependency_columns`, trigger `event`/`timing`, sequence bounds, materialized view clauses).
- **SQL Server (`backend/plugin/schema/mssql`)**:
  - Delegate `GetDatabaseMetadata` and `GetTableDefinition` in `mssql.go` to `omni/mssql/catalog.GetDatabaseMetadata` and `omni/mssql/catalog.GetTableDefinition` (preserving `stripTableUnrenderedFacts` for `SkipDump`, comments, triggers, and `DefaultConstraintName`).
  - Delete `get_database_metadata.go` (706 lines), `table_definition.go` (324 lines), and `register.go` (15 lines).
  - Update `get_database_metadata_test.go`, `cutover_definition_test.go`, and YAML fixtures for `omni/mssql/catalog`'s documented improvements (table-level PK `nullable: false`, `default_constraint_name`, sequence options, computed column expressions, filtered index predicates, `ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT` foreign keys, default-schema fallback, and constraint extended properties not polluting `table.Comment`).

title: refactor(db,schema): retire SessionQuerier, SQLDBProvider, and post-cutover shims
body:
## Summary

Retires the leftover post-cutover shims and `database/sql` escape hatches across `backend/plugin/db`, `backend/plugin/schema`, `backend/api/v1`, `backend/component/ghost`, `backend/runner`, and `go.mod`:

1. **Retire `db.SessionQuerier` and `db.SQLDBProvider`:**
   - Implemented `db.TaskRunSessionReader` on `backend/plugin/db/cockroachdb` using `d.inner.Session(ctx)`, so `backend/api/v1/rollout_service.go` (`getSession`) uses `db.TaskRunSessionReader` for both PostgreSQL and CockroachDB without `db.SQLDB(driver)`.
   - Migrated `backend/component/ghost/validator.go` (`ValidateBinlogAccess`) to run its 4 read-only MySQL binlog prerequisite checks through `driver.QueryConn(ctx, nil, ...)` and removed `RequireDirectConnection`; migrated `ghost_sync_executor.go` and `database_migrate_executor.go` temp-table cleanup to `driver.Execute(...)`.
   - Removed `db.SessionQuerier`, `db.OwnsQuerySession`, `db.SQLDBProvider`, and `db.SQLDB` from `backend/plugin/db/driver.go`, the `!db.OwnsQuerySession` / `sqlDB.Conn` branches in `backend/api/v1/sql_service.go`, and `OwnsQuerySession()`, `GetDB()`, and secondary `*sql.DB` pools (`sqlDB` / `newSQLDB` / `sqlPool`) across all `backend/plugin/db/*` drivers and tests.
2. **Delete `backend/plugin/db/mysql/sqlprobe.go`:**
   - Moved the test-only `explainJSON` / `estimateAffectedRows` helpers locally into `backend/plugin/advisor/mysql/mysql_rules_test.go` and `backend/plugin/advisor/mariadb/mariadb_rules_test.go` and deleted `sqlprobe.go`.
3. **Delete `backend/plugin/db/util/statement_parser.go` and `statement_parser_test.go`:**
   - Switched `backend/plugin/db/cassandra/cassandra.go` to `cassandraparser.SplitSQL`, updated `backend/plugin/db/bigquery/cutover_parity_test.go` to assert GoogleSQL's splitter/analyzer (`parser.SplitFlat` and `googlesqlanalysis.ClassifySQL`) directly, and deleted both `statement_parser*.go` files.
4. **Delete `backend/plugin/schema/function_comparer.go`:**
   - Removed the obsolete `TestCockroachMetadataMigrationIgnoresLegacyFunctionComparer` test reference in `backend/plugin/schema/pg/catalog_migration_test.go` and deleted `function_comparer.go`.
5. **`go.mod` / `go.sum` cleanup:**
   - Ran `go mod tidy` (demoting `github.com/DATA-DOG/go-sqlmock` and `github.com/jackc/pgtype` to indirect).

## Test Plan

- `GOGC=off GOMEMLIMIT=10GiB golangci-lint run -j 8 --allow-parallel-runners` (0 issues)
- `go build -ldflags "-w -s" -p=16 -o ./bytebase-build/bytebase ./backend/bin/server/main.go`

- `go test -v -count=1 ./backend/tests/ -run '^TestGhostSchemaUpdate$'`
